runtimeAdaptations: Saved floor text is read through api.messages.getFloor and its display record through api.variables.getFloor.
Active main-run text is rendered from api.messages.onTextStream; job streams do not replace the scene.
Choices and the custom input submit through api.chat.send after api.history.latest.
Runtime media channels replace the source script global Audio element.
Cancellable Runtime timers implement the source typewriter interaction and allow a stage click to reveal the current paragraph; Skip jumps to the last paragraph and reveals its complete text.
The 14 source CG aliases use fixed Runtime-registered gallery slots and unlock when their CG command is rendered.
The source display sliders map to fixed CSS size classes for the current Runtime instance.
differences: CG gallery unlocks and display slider values last for the current Runtime instance because the package API does not expose package-owned persistent UI storage.
The source BGM progress scrubber is omitted because the media API exposes play, pause, and stop but no seek or duration interface.
Unknown aliases remain hidden and produce a user-facing message; the package maps every alias declared by the source asset dictionary.
